About me

I came into content from IT, which is why I treat publishing as a system rather than a batch of tasks. A queue that fills itself beats a to-do list someone remembers to check.

That background is also why I build the boring parts: naming conventions, status tracking, and handover documents. When a process is written down, it survives a busy week, a holiday, and a change of hands.

I work in short-form video because it is daily, measurable, and unforgiving about consistency. If a slot is empty, you can see it.

No metrics. Concept work only.

Scope of work

  • Five content pillars mapped to stages of buyer awareness

A self-directed brief. Skin care brand with no following, no content history, and a launch in 30 days. I built the pillar structure, the grid rhythm, and the caption voice from zero. There is no client, no live account, and no growth to report. The planning work is real; the numbers are not claimed.
